ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity (white/light gray) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity regions occupy the interior of both lobes, bounded by a thick, continuous low-intensity perimeter. A distinct vertical low-intensity pillar bisects the fluke at the median notch. Sparse low-intensity mottling is distributed across the central high-intensity zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 72 degrees and high vertical depth relative to the fluke chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Amplitude of variations increases at the distal tips, particularly the left-most extremity.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a sigmoidal curve, concave near the median notch and transitioning to convex towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups detected within the low-intensity border regions, most concentrated near the median notch and the interior trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple low-intensity diagonal linear tracks (rake marks) on the left lobe. A singular, distinct curvilinear dark mark is visible on the inner portion of the right lobe near the vertical bisection.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a high-chroma reddish-brown pixel cluster attached to the far-left distal tip, inconsistent with fluke pigmentation (likely bio-fouling or entangled organic matter).
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent low-intensity vertical stripe originating at the median notch and widening as it descends toward the peduncle junction.
